author: MehdiJafari
quote: In every respect—gameplay, story, character development, sound design, music, atmosphere, and graphics—this is the greatest game in the history of the gaming industry. It is unlikely that anything comparable will appear for a long time; unless Rockstar decides to craft another such experience, you simply won't find its equal anywhere else in gaming. This title is a peerless, extraordinary masterpiece—a unique open-world achievement that excels in every single aspect, truly deserving of the highest accolades.

author: MehdiJafari
quote: This game stands out as one of my best experiences this year and the finest first-person shooter I have played in 2026. In terms of story, gameplay, music, sound design, atmosphere, and graphics, it delivers such a high-quality experience that every gamer should play it at least once to fully enjoy what it has to offer. Without a doubt, this title represents a magnificent return to the roots of the *Call of Duty* franchise, and I thoroughly enjoyed every aspect of the experience.

author: MehdiJafari
quote: This entry undoubtedly managed to recapture the spirit of the franchise's signature humor and became one of the most impactful games of the year for me. It is a title worth discussing at length, showcasing just how effectively a polished third-person shooter can be delivered to players—offering a magnificent package in terms of story and, especially, gameplay and gunplay.

author: MehdiJafari
quote: This game is undoubtedly the best title I have experienced this year: a stunningly beautiful story, masterful gameplay and combat, exceptional music and sound design, exemplary atmosphere and graphics, and—above all—unparalleled level design. It is an extraordinary, unforgettable work in every respect, and as I mentioned, it stands out as my game of the year.

author: MehdiJafari
quote: This game is the best game of my entire life because it is both in terms of the story, which presents a very beautiful and masterpiece story, and in terms of the gameplay, it is unique and wonderful, and it is also at the highest level in terms of sound and music, and in terms of the atmosphere and graphics, this game does not need my definition and everyone knows what I am saying. In short, this is a wonderful package of what we experienced and literally reminds us of the sentence that ((Why video games are an art)) and is the pioneer of the true art of video games and always carries this with it. In this review, I would like to say a big thank you to the Remedy Studio team, especially Sam Lake, because they made my best video game experience not only for me but for many other gamers.
